referee_caveats_inferred: CO(2-1) detections depend on ozone-line correction (tau suppressed by 20-30%); one CO(2-1) point is only S/N ~1.4
The CO(3-2) centroid is ~3 sigma discrepant, and T_ex(3-2) has large errors, so LTE/non-LTE conclusions rest on low-S/N data
RADEX fit uses fixed N_CO and FWHM and a 1-sigma contour that does not close, so n_H2 and T_bg are weakly constrained
Absorber location (foreground filament versus near-nuclear) rests on a T_bg interpretation that is degenerate with n_H2
Non-detection limits depend on HST-defined region shapes and alpha_CO = 3.1 and may differ for another region choice
Conclusions about spurious broad features rely on qualitative comparison of spws rather than a quantitative bandpass model
